summary: Two-Bedroom Terrace in Prime Eastbourne Location – Perfect Investment Opportunity Situated in the heart of the ever-desirable Eastbourne area, this two-bedroom terrace property offers an ideal combination of central living and investment potential.
description:
Just a short walk from the bustling town centre, local train station, schools, and an array of shops and amenities, it boasts a highly convenient location. Currently tenanted at £650 per calendar month, this property presents a fantastic investment opportunity, offering a consistent rental income in a popular rental area. Internally, the property briefly comprises an entrance lobby, spacious lounge, well-equipped kitchen, two comfortable bedrooms, and a practical Jack-and-Jill bathroom. Externally, the front forecourt garden provides a peaceful buffer between the house and the main road, while the rear features a fully enclosed courtyard with the added benefit of a garage, perfect for off-road parking or additional storage space.

ENTRANCE LOBBY The entrance lobby is accessed via a UPVC-framed double-glazed door, providing a welcoming entry to the property. This practical space serves as a transitional area, offering easy access to the lounge and providing a buffer from the outside elements.

LOUNGE A comfortable and inviting space, the lounge features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light to fill the room. A wall-mounted radiator ensures warmth and comfort throughout, making it an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining guests.

KITCHEN The kitchen is well-equipped with a range of base and wall units, complemented by durable laminate work surfaces. Integrated appliances include an oven, hob, and a stylish stainless steel chimney-style extractor unit. There is plumbing for a washing machine, and the room is filled with natural light from two UPVC-framed double-glazed windows. A door provides convenient access to the rear courtyard. Additional storage is available with a handy understairs cupboard, offering ample space for kitchen essentials.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

BEDROOM ONE A spacious double bedroom, featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that allows plenty of natural light to brighten the room. A wall-mounted radiator ensures comfort throughout the year, making it a perfect space for rest and relaxation. The room's generous size offers flexibility for various furniture layouts.

BEDROOM TWO A comfortable and well-proportioned room that features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that fills the space with natural light. The room also benefits from a wall-mounted radiator for warmth. Additionally, there is a convenient door leading to the Jack-and-Jill bathroom, making this room both practical and well-located.

FAMILY BATHROOM The Jack and Jill bathroom is fitted with a clean and functional white suite, comprising a panel bath with a mains-fed shower over, a wash hand basin, and a low-level WC. A wall-mounted radiator ensures the room stays comfortable, while a built-in storage cupboard offers convenient space for toiletries and essentials. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light to brighten the space and provides ventilation.

EXTERNALLY To the front of the property, there is an enclosed forecourt garden, providing a welcoming buffer between the house and the main road, with gated access for privacy and security. To the rear, you'll find an additional enclosed courtyard, offering a private outdoor space. This leads to a garage, providing valuable off-road parking or additional storage, enhancing the practicality and convenience of the property.
